The '''62nd Directors Guild of America Awards''', honoring the outstanding directorial achievements in [[film director|film]]s, [[documentary]] and [[television director|television]] in 2009, were presented on January 30, 2010, at the [[Hyatt Regency Century Plaza]].<ref>{{cite news|last1=DiOrio|first1=Carl|title=Kathryn Bigelow wins DGA Award|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/kathryn-bigelow-wins-dga-award-20117|access-date=January 20, 2018|work=The Hollywood Reporter|date=January 30, 2010}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=McNary|first1=Dave|title=DGA honors Bigelow for 'Hurt Locker'|url=https://variety.com/2010/film/awards/dga-honors-bigelow-for-hurt-locker-1118014513/|access-date=20 January 2018|work=Variety|date=January 30, 2010}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Kathryn Bigelow wins DGA Feature Film Award for The Hurt Locker. Other winners of 2009 DGA Awards announced. |url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2010/0131-Kathryn-Bigelow-wins-DGA-Feature-Film-Award-for-The-Hurt-Locker.aspx |publisher=Directors Guild of America |access-date=August 9, 2018 |date=January 31, 2010}}</ref> The ceremony was hosted by [[Carl Reiner]].<ref>{{cite web|title=DGA Sets Host and Presenters for 62nd Annual DGA Awards Dinner|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2010/0125-DGA-Sets-Host-and-Presenters-for-62nd-Annual-DGA-Awards-Dinner.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 20, 2018|date=January 25, 2010}}</ref> The nominees for the feature film category were announced on January 7, 2010,<ref>{{cite web|last1=Knegt|first1=Peter|title=Directors Guild Announces 2009 Nominees|url=https://www.indiewire.com/2010/01/directors-guild-announces-2009-nominees-246030/|website=IndieWire|access-date=January 20, 2018|date=January 7, 2010}}</ref> the nominations for the television and commercial categories were announced on January 8, 2010,<ref>{{cite news|last1=McNary|first1=Dave|title=DGA TV nominations announced|url=https://variety.com/2010/scene/awards/dga-tv-nominations-announced-1118013521/|access-date=January 20, 2018|work=Variety|date=January 8, 2010}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Nominees for Directorial Achievement in Movies for Television/Mini-Series, Dramatic Series Night, Comedy Series, Musical Variety, Reality Programs, Daytime Serials, Children's Programs, Commercials|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2010/0108-Nominees-for-Directorial-Achievement-in-Movies-for-Television-MiniSeries-Dramatic.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 22, 2018|date=January 8, 2010}}</ref> and the nominees for documentary directing were announced on January 12, 2010.<ref>{{cite web|last1=Pond|first1=Steve|title=DGA Doc Nominations: 'Anvil,' 'Cove,' 'Food Inc.'|url=https://www.thewrap.com/dga-doc-nominations-anvil-cove-food-inc-12852/|website=The Wrap|access-date=January 20, 2018|date=January 12, 2010}}</ref>
